metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 6 inches in Grafton, New South Wales during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Grafton, New South Wales (approximately -28.95°, 152.93°) - Date Range: January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020 - Data Source: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) for rainfall - CHIRPS is ideal for precipitation analysis at daily resolution 2. **Masking Strategy**: - No masking needed for CHIRPS; it's a precipitation dataset, not optical - Sum daily rainfall across the date range - Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (B): Calculated rainfall < 6 inches - Valid Non-Zero (A): Calculated rainfall >= 6 inches - C1: No images in the collection for the date range - C2: All pixels are invalid/masked (unlikely for CHIRPS) - C3: Result is NaN or calculation fails ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Grafton, NSW location const grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.93, -28.95]); // Define date range: January 14-22, 2020 const startDate = '2020-01-14'; const endDate = '2020-01-23'; // Exclusive end // Load CHIRPS daily rainfall data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(grafton); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images in range: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No rainfall data available for the date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Sum daily precipitation across the period const totalPrecip = chirps.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()); // Extract value at Grafton location const rainfallMM = totalPrecip.sample(grafton, 5000).first().get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Raw precipitation value: ${rainfallMM}`); // Validate result if (rainfallMM === null || rainfallMM === undefined || isNaN(rainfallMM)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid/null value.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const rainfallInches = rainfallMM / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall Jan 14-22, 2020: ${rainfallMM.toFixed(2)} mm (${rainfallInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: 6 inches`); console.log(`Images processed: ${collectionSize}`); // Determine answer if (rainfallInches >= 6.0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
